content.short: FungIPle is a Web3 IP empowerment and licensing platform that brings iconic Web2 IPs into Web3 using the 404 Hybrid NFT protocol.
content.description: FungIPle serves as a Web3 IP empowerment and licensing platform focused on translating iconic Web2 intellectual properties, such as SNK, into Web3. By leveraging the 404 Hybrid NFT protocol and integrating with Web3 games, FungIPle seeks to unlock higher market value and liquidity for leading IPs, strengthening their footprint in the Web3 ecosystem. This approach enables well-known Web2 IPs to enter Web3 and realize broader IP enablement across ecosystems.
